goodOutstanding.label: Good or Outstanding at latest graded Ofsted inspection
goodOutstanding.source: Ofsted, state-funded schools inspections and outcomes
goodOutstanding.basis: Share of schools with a graded inspection. A simple share of schools, not pupil-weighted.

reportCards.label: Schools with an Ofsted report card
reportCards.source: Ofsted, state-funded schools inspections and outcomes

year7NotOffered.label: Year 7 applicants not offered first preference
year7NotOffered.source: DfE, Primary and secondary school applications and offers 2026/27, local-authority file
year7NotOffered.basis: DfE's own council figure, as published, out of applications received by the council.

receptionNotOffered.label: Reception applicants not offered first preference
receptionNotOffered.source: DfE, Primary and secondary school applications and offers 2026/27, local-authority file
receptionNotOffered.basis: DfE's own council figure, as published, out of applications received by the council.

attainment8.label: Average Attainment 8 score
attainment8.basis: School averages weighted by the number of pupils at the end of key stage 4. Mainstream state secondary and all-through schools with a published score.

progress8.label: Average Progress 8 score
progress8.basis: School scores weighted by the number of pupils at the end of key stage 4. Mainstream state secondary and all-through schools with a published score. DfE did not publish Progress 8 for 2024-25 or 2025-26.

absence.label: Overall absence rate in secondary schools
absence.source: DfE, Pupil absence in schools in England
absence.basis: Secondary and all-through mainstream state schools only, because the primary absence file is not loaded here. School rates weighted by pupils on roll in the schools register. DfE does not publish a council rate with this weighting.

persistentAbsence.label: Persistent absence rate in secondary schools
persistentAbsence.source: DfE, Pupil absence in schools in England
persistentAbsence.basis: Pupils missing 10% or more of sessions. Secondary and all-through mainstream state schools only. School rates weighted by pupils on roll in the schools register.

ehcp.label: Pupils with an EHC plan
ehcp.source: DfE, Special educational needs in England
ehcp.basis: School percentages weighted by pupils on roll, which equals council pupils with a plan divided by council pupils. All state-funded schools, including special schools.

senSupport.label: Pupils on SEN support
senSupport.source: DfE, Special educational needs in England
senSupport.basis: School percentages weighted by pupils on roll. All state-funded schools, including special schools.

ptr.label: Pupils per teacher
ptr.basis: School ratios weighted by full-time-equivalent teachers, which equals council pupils divided by council teachers. Mainstream state schools only.

destinations.label: Pupils in a sustained destination after key stage 4
destinations.basis: Sustained education, apprenticeship or employment. School percentages weighted by cohort size. Mainstream state secondary and all-through schools.

dropped.spendingPerPupil: Academies and council-maintained schools report spending on different returns and for different years (2024/25 and 2025-26), so a council figure would mostly show how many of its schools are academies.
